dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section towards the visible posterior section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse greyish mottling observed primarily around the blowhole and along the central axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the faint greyish pigmented regions and the primary white baseline.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented transverse blowhole and a clearly defined longitudinal dorsal ridge.
